deployed_implementation.key_semantic: isChainlinkIndexBroken checks response validity but does not apply _chainlinkIsFrozen(chainlinkIndexResponse); the 14,400-second age predicate is applied to the price leg, not the index leg.

findings.finding: The frozen independent F/R encoded a nonexistent deployed index-age obligation. The observed RETURN_CURRENT action is consistent with exact PriceFeedV2 semantics, but no post-hoc reference correction is promoted to a formal independent comparison.

With the price leg frozen and index leg otherwise valid, exact PriceFeedV2 uses cached price and current index. The original RETURN_CACHED reference was based on the same incorrect index-age obligation.

The original classifier tested numeric equality before status/provenance. Because VE10.1 set both caches to 1e18, the mixed result in VE10.2 numerically equaled the current product. Trace and status transition establish the frozen NORMAL_TO_DEGRADED_TRANSITION reference action.
